sampling_endpoint.eligible_eventIDs: exact eventID rows in frozen pitfall_position_recovery.csv
sampling_endpoint.island: three-letter island prefix of the frozen core lineage in pitfall_position_recovery.csv
sampling_endpoint.presence: at least one eligible pitfall Occurrence row for the MF token with numeric organismQuantity > 0 in the island-phase
sampling_endpoint.surveyed_zero: no positive eligible pitfall Occurrence row for the taxon in an island-phase whose frozen island-phase quality_pass is true
sampling_endpoint.quantity_rule: organismQuantity must be finite numeric and nonnegative on every routed pilot pitfall row; any violation is STOP
sampling_endpoint.beating_rows: ignored for the primary pilot state and may not rescue pitfall zeros
sampling_endpoint.claim_ceiling: observed occurrence in standardized repeated native-forest pitfall sampling, not whole-island occupancy or extinction

taxon_eligibility.analysis_unit: normalized MF identificationRemarks token fixed by v1.135 routing
taxon_eligibility.native_status_rule: at least one nonblank establishmentMeans value and every nonblank value must be native or endemic
taxon_eligibility.hymenoptera_rule: Hymenoptera eligible only if every nonblank family value is Formicidae and at least one family value is Formicidae
taxon_eligibility.metadata_excluded_groups_guard: if Acari or Collembola appears explicitly in scientificName/class/order, exclude the MF token rather than zero-fill it
taxon_eligibility.scientificName_and_taxonRank: audit only; MF token remains the cross-phase identity and nomenclatural label variation does not split a token

three_wave_transition.t0_sources: islands present for the eligible pilot taxon in BALA1
three_wave_transition.lost_sources: t0 occupied islands absent at BALA2
three_wave_transition.primary_pilot_route: exactly one lost source between BALA1 and BALA2
three_wave_transition.target_population: a different island occupied at BALA2; the lost source is excluded and target self-anchor is excluded from its own t0 source set
three_wave_transition.t2_endpoint_for_estimability_only: 1 if the BALA2 target is absent at BALA3, 0 if it remains present

source_leverage_exposure.E_i: sum kernel(target,lost t0 sources) / sum kernel(target,all t0 sources excluding target self)
source_leverage_exposure.Q_loss: sum target-geometry pressure mass of the actually lost source divided by total pressure mass of all t0 sources, each source excluded from its own target geometry
source_leverage_exposure.pilot_use: compute exposure values only to test finite support and variation; do not relate exposure to t2 outcome direction or estimate predictive gain

estimability_gate.leverage_identifiability_beyond_source_c: within at least one t0 nominal source-count stratum, require >=5 target rows and >=3 distinct E_i values rounded to 1e-6; if only one source-count stratum exists overall, the same rule applies to that stratum
estimability_gate.pass_rule: all listed pilot thresholds must pass
estimability_gate.if_fail: STOP BALA primary source-loss route; no threshold, taxon-scope, pitfall-quality or loss-count rule may be relaxed after pilot response access

anti_selection: do not compute C-minus-R2, a leverage coefficient, correlation, odds ratio or outcome-stratified leverage summary in pilot
do not select taxa by source-loss direction or t2 outcome
do not switch from exactly-one-loss to a different primary loss-count route after pilot
do not alter the 20/30 site or 80-percent island pitfall quality thresholds
do not inspect sealed confirmatory row semantics
do not use beating data to rescue pitfall estimability
do not change the graph, lambda, taxon partition salt or native/endemic scope after pilot access
advance_if_pass: freeze confirmatory taxonomy eligibility and a phase-specific response firewall; then open confirmatory t0/t1 exposure rows only, freeze all source-loss features/reference/predictions, and keep confirmatory t2 outcomes sealed until final authorization
